defmodule InferenceServer.ModelRegistry do
  @moduledoc """
  Multi-tenant model registry with secure isolation.
  Models are stored per-tenant with strict access controls.
  """
  use GenServer

  defstruct [:models, :tenants, :config]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{models: %{}, tenants: %{}, config: load_config()}}
  end

  defp load_config do
    %{
      max_model_size: 100_000_000,
      allowed_frameworks: ["tensorflow", "pytorch", "onnx"],
      serialization_format: :etf
    }
  end

  def register_tenant(tenant_id, api_key) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:register_tenant, tenant_id, api_key})
  end

  def handle_call({:register_tenant, tenant_id, api_key}, _from, state) do
    hashed_key = :crypto.hash(:sha256, api_key) |> Base.encode16()
    tenants = Map.put(state.tenants, tenant_id, %{api_key_hash: hashed_key, quota: 1000})
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | tenants: tenants}}
  end
end

defmodule InferenceServer.TenantIsolation do
  @moduledoc """
  Ensures strict tenant isolation for model data and inference requests.
  """

  def validate_tenant_access(tenant_id, resource_tenant_id) do
    tenant_id == resource_tenant_id
  end

  def sanitize_tenant_id(tenant_id) when is_binary(tenant_id) do
    if Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/, tenant_id) do
      {:ok, tenant_id}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_tenant_id}
    end
  end

  def sanitize_tenant_id(_), do: {:error, :invalid_tenant_id}
end

defmodule InferenceServer.ModelLoader do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles model loading with format validation and size checks.
  Supports checkpoint restoration for long-running training jobs.
  """

  @max_payload_size 50_000_000

  def load_model(tenant_id, model_data, metadata) do
    with {:ok, _tid} <- InferenceServer.TenantIsolation.sanitize_tenant_id(tenant_id),
         :ok <- validate_payload_size(model_data),
         :ok <- validate_metadata(metadata),
         {:ok, model} <- deserialize_model(model_data, metadata) do
      {:ok, model}
    end
  end

  defp validate_payload_size(data) when byte_size(data) <= @max_payload_size, do: :ok
  defp validate_payload_size(_), do: {:error, :payload_too_large}

  defp validate_metadata(%{"framework" => fw, "version" => v}) when is_binary(fw) and is_binary(v) do
    if fw in ["tensorflow", "pytorch", "onnx"] do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :unsupported_framework}
    end
  end
  defp validate_metadata(_), do: {:error, :invalid_metadata}

  defp deserialize_model(data, %{"framework" => _fw} = metadata) do
    format = Map.get(metadata, "serialization", "json")
    do_deserialize(data, format)
  end

  defp do_deserialize(data, "json") do
    case Jason.decode(data) do
      {:ok, parsed} -> {:ok, %{weights: parsed, loaded_at: DateTime.utc_now()}}
      {:error, _} -> {:error, :invalid_json}
    end
  end

  defp do_deserialize(data, "msgpack") do
    case Msgpax.unpack(data) do
      {:ok, parsed} -> {:ok, %{weights: parsed, loaded_at: DateTime.utc_now()}}
      {:error, _} -> {:error, :invalid_msgpack}
    end
  end

  defp do_deserialize(data, "checkpoint") do
    # Checkpoint format uses safe ETF deserialization
    # Only allows existing atoms to prevent atom table exhaustion
    restore_checkpoint(data)
  end

  defp do_deserialize(_, _), do: {:error, :unsupported_format}

  defp restore_checkpoint(data) do
    try do
      term = :erlang.binary_to_term(data, [:safe])
      {:ok, %{weights: term, loaded_at: DateTime.utc_now()}}
    rescue
      ArgumentError -> {:error, :invalid_checkpoint}
    end
  end
end

defmodule InferenceServer.Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers,
    parsers: [:json],
    json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  post "/api/v1/:tenant_id/models/load" do
    with {:ok, tenant_id} <- InferenceServer.TenantIsolation.sanitize_tenant_id(tenant_id),
         {:ok, body, conn} <- Plug.Conn.read_body(conn, length: 50_000_000),
         {:ok, request} <- Jason.decode(body),
         encoded when is_binary(encoded) <- request["model_data"] || :missing,
         {:ok, model_data} <- Base.decode64(encoded) do
      metadata = request["metadata"]

      case InferenceServer.ModelLoader.load_model(tenant_id, model_data, metadata) do
        {:ok, _model} ->
          send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "loaded"}))
        {:error, reason} ->
          send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: to_string(reason)}))
      end
    else
      _ -> send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: "invalid_request"}))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "not found")
  end
end
